en: Black-and-white postcard showing a large multi-storey hospital building in a late 19th/early 20th century architectural style, with dormer towers and a hipped roof. In the foreground there is a garden or orchard with flowering trees and a dirt path, bordered by fences. A small figure, likely a child, stands in the grass. Along the bottom-left edge, printed caption text reads "Landkrankenhaus Meißen".
